sloka: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।अकम्पनो निकुम्भश्च शुकः सारण एव च ।। ७.२७.२८ ॥
transliteration: mārīcaśca prahastaśca mahāpārśvamahodarau ।akampano nikumbhaśca śukaḥ sāraṇa eva ca ।। 7.27.28 ॥

translations.english: Maricha, Prahasta, Mahaparshva, Mahodara, Akampana, Nikumbha, Shuka, and Sarana were among them.
